profile.headline: Software Engineer @Google | MSCS @NEU
profile.summary:
The question, "How can we make systems more secure and resilient?" has been a driving force throughout my career, beginning with my time at RayAegis Information Security and continuing today. Witnessing the real-world impact of cyber threats on businesses and governments, combined with hands-on experience in software and systems development, ignited my passion for cybersecurity and inspired me to pursue a Master’s degree in Computer Science at Northeastern University.

Recently, I had the opportunity to work as a Data Engineer Co-op at Geode Capital Management. This role deepened my understanding of the standards, responsibilities, and expectations of engineers in the business industry, offering valuable insights into the integration of technical expertise with business goals.

With a diverse background spanning cybersecurity, network, software development, and systems engineering, I am eager to bring my skills and insights to my next role. Whether as a DevOps, data, network, security, or software engineer, I am ready to contribute to building innovative, secure, and efficient solutions for tomorrow's challenges.

positions.description:
- Revitalized legacy data validation application, significantly improving operational efficiency for the operations teams by 90%.

- Created detailed wireframes using Figma to translate client requirements into visual designs.

positions.title: Research Assistant (Remote)
positions.description:
- Conducted research on Snort 3 feature integration, identifying forward-compatible solutions for long-term product stability.
- Integrated security tools into CI/CD pipelines to enforce DevSecOps practices.
- Enhanced the CI/CD process by 25% to facilitate version control, security checks, and deployment.
- Improved threat detection accuracy by 70% by filtering false-positive malicious detection rules in Sandboxing environments

positions.title: Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the foundational development of the Sandboxing product, architecting the NoSQL database design, multi-processing workflows, and REST API endpoints.
- Enhanced suspicious file detection accuracy through optimization of custom analyzer in the Sandbox by 80%.
- Customized CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and Jenkins, improving deployment efficiency and quality control by 75%.
- Automated regression testing processes, reducing manual testing requirement by 80%.
- Enhanced the Next Generation Firewall product to improve threat detection, user experience, and access control mechanisms.
- Coordinated internal teams and managed communication with clients for customer succeed.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Engineered a responsive Next.js web application featuring online payments, server-side rendering, and SEO optimization.
- Customized Chakra UI components to precisely match UX/UI design specifications.
- Implemented a Strapi-based backend system with integrated database functionality.
- Modified Stripe’s payment controller to generate customized payment links for improved user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Stripe (Software) · Next.js · Oral Communication · Figma (Software) · Front-End Development · Node.js · Strapi.js

projects.title: Extensive Study on PoisonedRAG
projects.description:
- Analyzed the rationale behind the research paper Poisoned RAG (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.07867) and its implications
- Conducted experiments with various parameter setting for closed-ended questions to challenge the give rationale.
- Extended the study to evaluate its impact on open-ended question answering.
- Designed targeted prompts for LLMs to generate responses for open-ended questions.

projects.title: DEMO – DNS Vulnerability
projects.description:
- Simulated a classic DNS Vulnerability - DNS Flood - by using Docker containers.
- Configured an internal container network by leveraging Docker Network capabilities.
- Automated multi-container service deployment using Docker Compose.
